programme.desc: A romantic miniseries based on the web-toon of the safe title! Bo-nee, who wholeheartedly believes in superstitions, meets a man who believes in science and mathematics. She has to find a man born in the Year of the Tiger according to her fortuneteller, and soon after she gets entangled with a man who has never shown any interest in women or even dated one. programme.title: My Troublesome Star Ep.12
programme.desc: Actress Im Se Ra (Jang Da A) is on top of the world after becoming the youngest winner of a best actress award. Unfortunately, that same night, she's hit by a truck - and transported 25 years into the future, where she wakes up in the body of middle-aged woman Bong Cheong Ja (Uhm Jung Hwa). Cheong Ja decides to return to acting, hoping to restore her former glory and figure out what happened to her. She's assisted by Dokgo Cheol (Song Seung Heon), a former violent crimes detective who got demoted to traffic duty... and who shares a mysterious past connection with Se Ra. To both Cheong Ja and Cheol's surprise, they begin to fall for each other, sending their lives onto an entirely new trajectory.

programme.title: Wild Colombia
programme.desc: Colombia is truly unique. A magical land of wildly diverse landscapes where mirror-like wetlands fringe verdant rainforests, mangroves meander through vast grasslands and snow-capped mountain peaks emerge from misty, jungle-clad slopes. Making it home to a staggering variety of wildlife an evolutionary paradise and one of the most bio-diverse countries on earth.

programme.title: World's Rarest
programme.desc: The world is facing an urgent biodiversity crisis. Untold numbers of animals are at risk of being lost forever, with many species racing towards extinction. In this show, we try to highlight some of these incredible creatures, from the plucky pangolins to the critically endangered rhinoceroses, who live in constant fear of the poacher's bullet. Films provide a record of Earth's wonderful wildlife, but this is hopefully not an archive of what's lost, but evidence of what we should be preserving.

programme.title: Bucketlist Africa
programme.desc: Africa: one of the most iconic and diverse continents. It's packed with a spectacular range of habitats and environments, and home to some of the best loved and dramatic wildlife on the planet. From the small and surprising to the enormous and entertaining, there's something for everyone's bucket list on this vast continent. From camels to giraffes, gorillas to buffalo, the sheer range of wildlife found in Africa is unbelievable. With so much to see, where would you begin your bucket list adventure?

programme.title: Stork Army: Women Fighting for the Hargila
programme.desc: In South East Asia the Greater Adjutant Stork, known locally as the Hargila, is a sight to behold. But this towering bird has seen its numbers dwindling rapidly to the point of endangerment. One woman has made it her mission to save this species from extinction. Purnima Devi Burman decided she had to take matters into her own hands, with no support from the government or financial resources, she raised a team of female environmental warriors to join her fight to save the Hargilas. She christened them ‘The Hargila Army' - and this is their story.

programme.title: Colours of Nature
programme.desc: From subtle to shocking, colour enhances the beauty of the natural world. Colour is a language to most living things, whether as a warning, camouflage or a come on. But there's more to colour than just pigment. Colours define how many animals behave, how they mate and how they inter-act with one another. For us the beautiful and varied shades of the animal kingdom form a spec-tacular kaleidoscope of colours. With all the diversity in the world, sit back and enjoy all the col-ours of the animal kingdom.

programme.title: Hunters of the Forest
programme.desc: Forests are dark, shady habitats, realms of shadows perfect for predators to lurk. The dense plant growth facilitates a wealth of prey species, and cunning predators of all shapes and sizes have adapted to exploit every niche. Whether crawling on the forest floor, gliding through the trees or stalking the shadows in between, hunters have mastered the terrain in every type of forest imagina-ble. And they're not just stealthy, they're also some of the most enigmatic and beautiful creatures on the planet.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: Wild and unknown lies the still undiscovered natural paradise of Bosnia and Herzegovina in the heart of Europe. Rough mountains, dense forests and wild waterfalls characterize the picture of the untouched landscapes. Lynx, wolves and bears roam mountains and valleys. One of the last primeval forests in Europe is a retreat for many endangered animal species. Bosnia and Herzegovina is actually an undiscovered natural paradise in the middle of Europe.

programme.title: Bosnia Herzegovina
programme.desc: The barren, karstic south of the country, Herzegovina, also impresses with its natural landscapes. One of them is the Livno field. Not only is it the largest wetland in the country, it is also the largest regularly flooded karst field in the world. About 700 wild horses live in this unique landscape. Their ancestors were working horses that were abandoned here more than 50 years ago. Another special feature of the karst landscape are the rivers with their tufa barriers. The countless waterfalls that pour over it are a unique natural phenomenon.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Winter means more than just the beginning of the year for the people of Lofoten: For more than a thousand years, Lofoten has been a hub for cod fishing, with seasons lasting from February to April as huge shoals migrate from the Barents Sea to these waters. During these hectic months, more than 65,000 tons of fish are brought to shore, securing the income for the whole of Lofoten for years to come. Around a quarter of the fish caught ends up on lines to dry upon racks. From a young age, the children from the fishing villages get to earn some pocket money by cutting cod tongues and selling the produce as a delicacy appreciated by the locals.

programme.title: One Year in Norway's Lofoten
programme.desc: Almost unnoticeably, spring turns into summer. The days become longer and longer, with a never-setting sun. People who have spent their winter and spring working hard can finally enjoy their own nature, even though the temperature is only slightly warmer. Lofoten is sparsely populated, just 24,000 people live here. Unstad is one of its smallest communities with only 15 inhabitants, but despite that, it has become a hotspot for arctic surf and is host to the northern-most surf center in the world. Surfers from all over the globe come to surf in the arctic water.

programme.title: Wild Faces of Switzerland
programme.desc: In the heart of Europe lies Switzerland. It's a surprisingly big little country: small in area, but big on natural beauty. And, like its many languages and cultures, its scenic diversity is something really special, too: from mighty Alps, dense forests and lush green valleys, to mysterious moors and roaring waterfalls. Mediterranean lakes and craggy rock landscapes are all close together in one small geographical location. Switzerland has many wild faces – some familiar and some hidden. It's a country that's astonishingly rich in variety, wilderness and scenic wonder. Each episode of the series seeks to do justice to this diversity.

programme.title: Berlin from Above
programme.desc: Unique pictures from above. This documentary shows a different angle of people and country, during a glide flight above the metropolis. More than 25 years after the reunion between East and West Germany, this movie shows pictures from different perspectives. Which visions and dreams marked this region? What changed and what emerged in Germany's tensed city. We take a look from above to see the city and its citizens. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to see how the people make this area their home. The movie unites nature, urbanity, tranquility and the rush of a metropolis. It unites parks and skyscraper canyons, lake capes and wetlands, curvy courses of rivers and straight streets. With exhilarating pictures we take a trip through Berlin- from sunrise til sunset. Due to high quality flight recordings and panorama pictures, we are able to get a glimpse at how the people make this area their home.

programme.title: Street of Gongs
programme.desc: In Thailand's rural northeast you will find the street of Gongs. Outside the provincial capital of Ubon Ratchatani in Thailand's rural northeast, a country road nearly thirty kilometers long stretches to the banks of the Mekong River. Even from a distance, you can hear what is being made there: gongs of all sizes in nearly 50 manufactories. The gong is considered the ancient instrument and symbol of Asia. It occupies an important cultural significance, initiates rituals, expels demons, gives strength and courage. This film visits the creators of these unique instruments - a family business that has been laboriously handcrafting gongs for generations. They have a big mission: The abbot of the temple has ordered a new, large gong for the upcoming festival. Will they be able to finish it in time?

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake

programme.desc: At the girls' campout, Sour launches into a whopper of a yarn about the adventures she and Sweet had in the "Berry Deep Dark Forest." programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Apple isn't paying attention when Strawberry describes their campout tradition of telling "Tall Tales." So Apple tells her thrilling adventure of a wild road rally she entered, only to surprise the girls by proving the story is actually true.

programme.title: Strawberry Shortcake
programme.desc: Apple's rave review on her berryweb page of Strawberry's new dessert starts a booming mail order dessert business for Berry Bitty City. programme.title: Stiix and Stones
programme.desc: The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply so the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks – and when they fail to make enough cash, the Ninja decide to steal it – but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. The Ninja travel to the Village of Stiix to find the thief who stole the scroll of Airjitzu, but when the self-serving Ronan isn't keen to sell it cheaply, the Ninja must figure out a way to make money on the docks. Meanwhile, reluctant to give up being Samurai X, Nya struggles to embrace being a Water Ninja, and Sensei Wu gives her a riddle to figure out. Back at Stiix, when the Ninja fail to make enough cash working the docks, the Ninja decide to steal it... but have a run in with Moro and Sowlarcha. After Moro gets away with the scroll, the Ninja are left dangling, but Ronan saves them at a price – for a piece of their share in the Tea Farm.

programme.title: Public Enemy Number One
programme.desc: The Ninja must find out as much as they can about Nadakhan before he finds the Realm Crystal to save his crew, but after the Ninja are labeled enemies by the world they used to protect, our heroes find themselves hunted by their old friend, Ronan. With the Destiny's Bounty impounded, the police hire Ronin to track down the fugitive ninja. Misako has been arrested and is confronted by Nadakhan, who reveals he has trapped Wu in the Teapot of Tyrahn. Misako accidentally reveals the location of the Realm Crystal. The ninja discover that Wu was researching djinn when he disappeared and split up to learn more about their potential new foe. Lloyd and Zane head to the Library of Domu. While there, Ronin hacks into Zane's systems and shuts him down, then captures Lloyd. Ronin uses Zane's SOS beacon to lure Kai and Nya into the desert, where they are captured. Later, Cole and Jay are defeated by Ronin as well. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has used his powers to foil the high-tech security guarding the Realm Crystal and steals it. The ninja are hauled off to Kryptarium Prison and Nadakhan is free to gather his lost crew.

programme.title: Enkrypted
programme.desc: The secret, he says, is the venom of a Tiger Widow, a rare creature that lives on only one island. The venom can slow a djinn down. Soto is the only one who knows where the island is and will only tell if the ninja break him out of jail. Meanwhile, Nadakhan has decided to return to his home realm of Djinjago, only to discover it is falling apart. The ninja's destruction of the Cursed Realm is affecting the realms connected to it. Nadakhan uses the Djinn Blade to smash the Teapot, absorbing all the spirits that were trapped there into the sword. Falsely imprisoned, the Ninja are at their lowest point, but find an unlikely friend in an old enemy. Meanwhile, Nadakhan rescues his marooned crew and gains a new perspective, along with a new mysterious plan. With the ninja imprisoned, Nadakhan uses the Realm Crystal to free his old crew. The ninja encounter Captain Soto, the first captain of the Destiny's Bounty, who tells them the story of how he originally trapped Nadakhan in the Teapot. Nadakhan vows revenge on the ninja and NINJAGO. The ninja and Soto escape from jail, only to find out the map to the island is on Nadakhan's ship. Nadakhan discovers that Nya looks just like Delara, his long-lost love.

programme.title: Misfortune Rising
programme.desc: The ninja's search for Nadakhan's ship turns up nothing. Nadakhan's crew is struggling to handle an airship which used to sail only on the oceans. Nadakhan confronts Jay and talks him into making a wish that will win him Nya. Jay wishes that he wasn't born in a junkyard and was rich. The next moment, he receives a letter saying his father has died and he has inherited his estate. Jay rushes home to find his parents in the junkyard and finds out they are fine, but they reveal that he is adopted. Jay discovers that his real father is the actor who played his favorite movie hero. In an effort to trap the ninja, the Sky Pirates start raids all over NINJAGO City. Nadakhan kidnaps Kai, who makes two wishes, both of which go wrong. His third wish is to “make it all go away.” Nadakhan's first mate, Flintlocke, accidentally destroys the Realm Crystal and Cole steals Soto's map. The Destiny's Bounty mysteriously vanishes from the police impound yard.The Ninja are on a collision course to find the map to stop Nadakhan, they first must find him. Meanwhile, Jay makes a wish to change his future, but it could alter his past indefinitely.

programme.title: The Cloud
programme.desc: A storm is brewing over Knighton. Monstrox has taken the form of a cloud, and is raising an army of lightning infused Stone Monsters. His first target is the new Lavalands Amusement Park. Harmony reigns in Knighton as the Knights pursue their civilian lives: Lance has a TV talk show Axl is the singing chef on the show Jestro is the weatherman Clay is teaching at the Knights' Academy Macy, Ava and Merlok 2.0 travel the land in the Fortrex making sure the kingdom's defenses are ready (part of a plan she and Clay have) Aaron and his hover shield is travelling the land setting extreme records. Robin is at his workshop at the Knights' Academy doing an “independent study” – he's working on some top secret project for Merlok 2.0. It all seems excellent! We even see the Knights new vehicles – which have been optimized for civilian life (except for Clay's.) But storm clouds are brewing. Well, one storm cloud is brewing: the Cloud of Monstrox! Yes, the Book of Monsters has reconstituted himself and is now a cloud who needs a man on the ground to enact his new evil plan. He follows his old buddy Jestro as he goes across the realm on the weekends apologizing for being evil. ZAP! With one bolt of his evil magic lighting, the Cloud of Monstrox turns Jestro evil again (only this time a bit, well, too evil.) The evil duo are back together – and bring stone to life for the first time in the form of Gargoyles from the town of GHOULIA. Now they must gather the Forbidden Powers so that the Cloud of Monstrox can destroy the entire kingdom! A battle breaks out in the Lava Lands, where Lance and Alice Squires are reporting from the opening of the Cuthbert Richmond funded Lava Lands Amusement Park, rebuilt from the remains of Jestro's old HQ. Jestro and the Cloud are after something in the remains and as Merlok 2.0 sends out a call for the Knights to help Lance. Can Lance (with an assist from King Halbert in his Mech) hold-off Jestro, the Cloud and their new army of stone fighters?!

programme.title: A Little Rusty
programme.desc: The Cloud of Monstrox and Jestro unlocks a mysterious Forbidden Power. What kind ofhavoc will they unleash? And can Merlok 2.0 and the NEXO KNIGHTS make the new COMBO NEXO Powers work? The Knights finally make it to the Lava Lands – using their various new forms of transport, which are all strictly civilian vechicles – and they must regroup and learn to fight together again to face the new threat of Jestro, the Cloud of Monstrox, and their STONE MONSTERS (in this case, Stone Gargoyles.) But Jestro and his monsters beat back the knights and recover the STAFF OF MONSTROX – which was buried under the ceremonial chamber from Episode 210 (and is now the Lava Puker amusement park ride) – and they get away on Jestro's EVIL MOBILE, which he recovers from the HQ garage. Macy says this is exactly why she's been touring the kingdom preparing everyone for the next attack. The Knights have to get it together because now the entire kingdom is under threat…again. Robin decides he must upgrade the Knights' vehicles and make them more “fight optimized.” Ava and Merlok 2.0 must figure out how to use new NEXO Powers because regular NEXO Powers do make Stone monsters back into stone, but the Cloud simply zaps them to life again. Meanwhile, in the IRON MOUNTAINS, Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox find the first of the Forbidden Powers: RELENTLESS RUST. They find the ROGUL STATUE holding the power and zap him to life. Now…they can rust those shiny knights to pieces! Ava and Merlok are attempting to use NEXO COMBO POWERS – with hilarious results – as they try to figure out how they might work. When Jestro attacks, he's able to halt the Fortrex by instantly rusting its tracks and wheels! Robin has his hands full trying to clean all the rust from the attack of Relentless Rust. As the Knights attempt to defend against Jestro, the Cloud is zapping statues to life. He hits a statue with a bolt of lightning as Clay is touching it. Something happens…Clay feels odd stiff as if rock is mixing with his body. Finally, Ava and Merlok 2.0 download to the Knights their new thing: a COMBO NEXO COMBO Power. It works! It can smash the animated statues to dust! They use it to defeat Jestro, but he and the Cloud get away with the Forbidden Power of Relentless Rust. Victory … sort of. Clay talks to Merlok 2.0…something has happened to him. What can they do? Merlok 2.0 is very concerned.

programme.title: Thunderstox
programme.desc: Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox encounters the sculptor. He helps unleash a horde of fierce garden gnomes on Knighton. What will the NEXO KNIGHTS do against this new enemy? Will their new COMBO NEXO Powers do the trick? As Jestro and the Cloud of Monstrox head off on the Evil Mobile to 'store' the Forbidden Power in a secret location, they encounter…THE SCULPTOR. His real name is ROBERTO ARNOLDI. He's a sensitive and odd artist who has been laid off by the king (the King ordered a "smashing" statue of the Queen, and the Sculptor made a statue of the Queen literally smashing monsters. He takes everything very literally.) Jestro instructs him to make a "bad" statue that he can use to attack the knights. The Sculptor sets to work. Meanwhile, the NEXO KNIGHTS are discussing the COMBO NEXO Powers, the Forbidden Powers, and what all this means. Lance, meanwhile, decides that since his talk show career is on hold, he thinks he'll install cameras in the Fortrex and do a Big Brother-like expose show on the Knights (he decides NOT to tell the others.) Merlok 2.0 and the Cloud of Monstrox (each talking to their cohorts) explain the history of the Forbidden Powers: it's a history lesson about the WIZARDS' COUNCIL, the Forbidden Powers, and how they were stopped long ago. This visual montage leads Jestro to…MOUNT THUNDERSTROX. The Cloud of Monstrox shows him the circle of ten Standing Stones where he will insert the Forbidden Powers. "What'll happen after that?” asks Jestro, curious. "Oh, I don't want to spoil the surprise," says the Cloud. They insert the first Forbidden Power, Relentless Rust, and it locks into place on its stone. They go off to battle the Knights and collect the "bad" statue the sculptor is making. But he's made a literally bad statue…it's terrible ... garden gnomes. Like an amateur art student. And…it's not even finished. ("You can't rush bad genius!") The Knights attack with their newly modified vehicles and they succeed in destroying the Evil Mobile. They then try to use a COMBO NEXO Power, but can't…it had to be perfect to work (Ava and Merlok need to work on it.) As Jestro and the Cloud retreat, Merlok again talks to Clay about turning to stone! Merlok calls in Robin…he will need him to build something to help Clay as he becomes more and more impaired.

programme.title: Weekend At Halberts
programme.desc: Party time in Knighton! The mood is down so the King decides to throw a party. In the meantime Jestro attacks the Fortrex, but he is confronted with the new NEXO Power "The Wedgie of Doom". Clay is turned to stone and everyone is gloomy. Especially King Halbert. In order to get everything in a better mood Aaron organizes a celebration. The King wants a reenactment of Clay's heroic rescue of the Queen. He is (as usual) totally unaware of Clay's situation. In order not to disappoint him further, the Knights get a remote control for Clay's Battle suit and is thus able to “perform” as Clay. Lance is happy to exercise his acting abilities and quickly gets into the role of the uptight knight of knights. Ava is working on reinstalling Merlok 2.0 into the Fortrex with Robin. She is also preparing the Fortrex for a visit from the new Knights' Academy novices. It is a fieldtrip with Principal Brickland and Sir Griffiths with the goal of teaching the kids about these new so-called High-tech battle strategies. Not really feeling it for anything modern, it quickly turns into a regular trip back memory lane for Brickland and Sir Griffiths. This out of control excursion is an excellent moment for Jestro who is looking for an opportunity to cheer up the defeated Monstrox. Unfortunately, for Jestro, Ava is able to make Merlok 2.0 functional again, and the Novices are able to fight Jestro and his monsters off using the NEXO Power: Wedgie of Doom. It is a humiliating defeat. Apparently, this is just what the doctor ordered for Monstrox. A good laugh at someone else's expense. His evil mood is back on.

He learns that the Sons of Garmadon frequent a karaoke bar called LAUGHY'S. Zane and Cole don disguises to infiltrate the bar. Unfortunately, during the routine, his disguise comes loose and he is exposed as a ninja. The Sons of Garmadon attack him, and Zane (who is still in disguise) is unable to intervene. programme.title: Masha and the Bear
programme.desc: To play in a quartet is not so easy as it seems, especially if there is no slack between musicians. This is what Masha tells Papa Bear, who came to visit. programme.title: Masha and the Bear

programme.desc: Have you ever heard that the world around is full terrible plagues and diseases? One boy called Semushka knows it for sure! Wherever he threw a glance – he seemed to see tetanus, rubella and other kinds of chickenpoxes…The poor boy was so terrified that began to squish his nose even harder. The only saving measures was an aid kit which his grandmother has put in his backpack “just in case” and a little spacesuit…Basically…this grim “testament” about such a snotty boy came out to be the most educative one!

programme.title: Masha's Spooky Stories

programme.desc: Do you know what children are scared the most of at school? What makes them tremble?! Here is a boy called Arkasha who really doesn't like history lessons. When he opened his eyes he saw all the range of historic characters chastising him for his illiteracy, and Napoleon was even ready to hit him on the head with a globe! Arkasha was so scared that vowed to learn all the names and dates, otherwise how could he protect himself from such nervous historic creatures?!

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: There was a village and a man, living in this village. In a deep forest near that village, the Bear settled in. The Bear asked the man for some tasty treats. The man gave the Bear two options of what he prefers to eat: the tops or the roots. The Bear decided to take the tops. The man grew a turnip and gave the tops to the Bear. The tops were tasteless. The Bear asked the man to try the turnip. The man agreed on the condition that the Bear will help him with the housework and keep off the flies. While chasing away the flies, the Bear accidentally hit the man on the nose. The Bear was scared and ran away into the forest, grabbing the turnip with him. Since then, people use to say “to be a fool for one's pains”.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: This story is about one very kind, but very poor Ali-Baba and his rich but greedy brother Kasym. Once upon a time Ali-Baba overheard the magic spell, which opens up the magic cape with numerous treasures. These treasures were stolen by the thieves and kept in this cave. One day Ali-Baba met Kasym and told him the secret spell. Kasym got inside the cape, but accidentally forgot the spell and the thieves caught him. They forced Kasym to learn the whole book of fairy tales by heart and spend one thousand days and a thousand and one nights telling these stories to them. This story teaches us to study well and avoid cheating.

programme.title: Masha's Tales
programme.desc: Once upon a time there lived a fisherman with his wife. Nearby there lived the Fox. One day the man went to a frozen pond to fish. On his way he found the Fox, who pretended to be dead, and picked her up. The Man started to fish and fell asleep over an ice-hole. The Wolf saw this and was glad as he hoped to get some fish, but the Fox told the Wolf that it's her own fisherman and if he wants to eat some fish - he should put in his own tail in an ice-hole. The Wolf's tail froze in the ice and fishes made a cute Christmas tree out of it. The Man, his Wife, the Fox, the Cat and the Mouse finally pulled the Wolf's tail out of the hole and the New Year has finally come.

programme.title: Masha's Tales

programme.desc: This story is about a 19yr old girl named Chunari, who dreams of marriage and a happy family. programme.title: PAAPNAASHNI GANGA
programme.desc: Paapnaashini Ganga Is A Mythological Show Based On The Life Of Goddess Ganga. The Show Takes The Viewers On The Journey Of Birth And Life Of Ganga. The Reason Behind Ganga'S Birth Was To Destruct Evil Entities. The Powers Of Adishakti Made Mainavati Give Birth To A Female Child Who Became Known As Ganga. Devatas Considered Ganga'S Purity As A Weapon Which Could Destroy Evil Asuras. As A Humble & Virtuous Woman, Ganga'S Entire Life Was Full Of Hardships, Which She Led Washing Away The Sins Of All Of Humanity Without Any Discrimination. Ganga Had Sacrificed All Her Desires On The Altar Of Dharma And Led A Divine Life Full Of Welfare Of Humanity. The Show Is Visually Appealing With Strong Vfx Which Will Enhance The Viewers Experience.

programme.title: MAATA KI MAHIMA
programme.desc: In the divine saga inspired by Bhakt Prahlad, witness the journey of Mahima, a devout disciple of Maata, as she challenges the tyranny of Indrayani, whose sins overflow in a reign of oppression. Sent into the heart of Indrayani's lineage, Mahima embodies the triumph of faith over darkness, destined to end the era of tyranny and usher in an era of righteousness.

programme.title: BETI HAMARI ANMOL
programme.desc: In this hugely inspirational success story, Anmol, a small town girl, not only fights the societal obstacles faced by any small town girl in our country but also takes on the social stigma she has had to face for being so short heighted that she has been termed as a “dwarf”. Anmol, with her strong will power and belief in herself, fights the hate she has had to receive from her in-law's. Anmol becomes a doctor with the support of her husband, in the same hospital where her father works as a peon, to win back her dignity as well as bring a lot of pride to her and her in law's family.

programme.title: BHABHI KE PYAARE PRITAM HAMARE
programme.desc: Bhabhi Ke Pyare Pritam Humaare Is A Light-Hearted Celebrity Chat Show Hosted By One Of India'S Most Famous Rj– Pritam Singh. In Each Episode, He Will Welcome Top Female Celebrities From The Entertainment Industry Who Have Played The Roles Of Bhabhi'S & Bahu'S On-Screen, Adding A Pinch Of Glamour To The Show. These Female Celebrities Will Talk About Their Real-World, Tell Their Untold Stories And Reveal How They Live Off-Camera. What'S More? The Episodes Of This Chat Show Will Have An Enthralling Line-Up Of Gag Artists, Activities/Games & Comedy Segments, Along With The Barrel Of Laughs – Pritam.

programme.title: JANANI
programme.desc: When children are young, parents care for them and give them all they need to live a good life. The circle of life, however, means that one day, it is the children's turn to care for their parents and give them a happy retired life. In the current moral fabric of society, rarely and not often it works out that way. It didn't happen that way with Savita too, as her children had no time to look after her. So she decided not to settle out and reinvent her life. She embarks on a journey to discover herself and to make her own identity as an individual. Janani tells an inspirational story of a mother who rose against all odds and became successful.

programme.title: STORIES BY RABINDRANATH TAGORE
programme.desc: The Characters Of Tagore'S Stories Spring Into Life Through The Cinematic Imagination Of Acclaimed Filmmaker, Anurag Basu In ‘Stories By Rabindranath Tagore'.Tagore'S Words And Basu'S Vision Have Amalgamated Into A Show That Transports You Back In Time To A World As Complicated As This One But With Far More Appeal And Beauty.

programme.title: DO CHUTKI SINDOOR
programme.desc: Vinayak and Siddhi live in Agra and Siddhi has a sister named Maya, who has a mental capacity of a 9-year-old. Siddhi takes full responsibility of Maya and ensures she is never left alone. Sunaina, their stepmother worries about Maya. Siddhi assures Sunaina that she will not marry until she finds someone who will take care of Maya. On the other hand, Vinayak who is the only son of rich and famous Jayadevi, a shrewd woman who despises the colour black. Vinayak and Siddhi's paths cross when Maya is about to get hit by Vinayak's car. Siddhi intervenes and saves Maya, but in anger slaps Vinayak for calling Maya "Pagal" (crazy). Vinayak realizes that he has fallen for Siddhi and promises to take care of Maya and marries Siddhi to seek revenge and make Maya suffer.

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the band Silica Gel! Known for their iconic explosive energy this quartet impressed both listeners and critics with their self-titled debut album Silica Gel in 2016. Not surprisingly they swept various major rookie awards that year and quickly became new leaders of the Korean indie music scene. Back in December 2017 after the release of the EP SiO2.nH2O Silica Gel took a hiatus to complete their mendatory military duties and then returned in August this year with the much-anticipated new single KYO181. In this episode Silica Gel performs KYO181 NEO SOUL Nap and more to showcase their unchaning unpredictable energy and sound just like their name. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and take a glimpse into their experimental yet genuine musicality!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is the multi-talented musician Ahn Ye-eun! This artist made herself known to the public in 2015 as the runner-up of the audition program K-Pop Star Season 5. During the show she amazed the public with her songwriting skills including Red Tie which she wrote after watching the film The King and the Clown. 2 years later Red Tie was featured in the soundtrack of the TV series The Rebel along with another one of her compositions Magic Lily. This past August she released her third single Trumpet Creeper which is about a court lady once loved by the king but forgotten soon. With her trademark heartrending voice she presents a beautiful harmony of pop and traditional sounds. In this episode Ahn Ye-eun performs Red Tie Trumpet Creeper KAKOTOPIA Goblin and more to showcase the quintessence of her artistry. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and enjoy her unique music!

programme.title: I'M LIVE
programme.desc: Joining us on this week's I'm LIVE is super-talented singer Lydia Lee! Back in 2015 one high school student posted her cover of Adele's smash single “Hello” to YouTube. The video quickly went viral worldwide garnering about 14 million views in just three weeks. It's none other than Lydia Lee. Soon after that she appeared in The Ellen DeGeneres Show as the second Korean after PSY. What's more the American magazine People also chose her rendition as the best cover of Hello. 2 years later in 2017 Lydia Lee released her debut album Blue and in August this year she returned to the music scene with the EP The House That I Live In. In this episode this artist performs Blue Don't Matter Villa Deshayes Grey to Green Farewell John and her cover of Sam Kim's Make Up. Tune in to I'm LIVE this week and see once again how she mesmerizes the world!

programme.desc: A light and peppy anchor driven half-hour episodic series that explores the reasons, bellefs and logic behind the customs and rituals observed as a norm In India, often so casually that most of us have never really asked why they arethe way they are.

programme.title: MID WICKET TALES
programme.desc: Veteran actor, Naseeruddin Shah, explores the many untold stories of Indian cricket. He recalls the history of the game match highlights. Sportsmanship, stadiums, hits and misses, and many more. In his unique narrative style, Naseeruddin Shah brings alive the humorous side of the game, along with undocumented anecdotes and quirky trivia. The show also features many personalities who narrate cricketing experiences and stories including Shashi Tharoor, Narl Contractor, Bishan Singh Bedi and Charu Sharma amongst others

programme.title: RAJA RASOI AUR ANDAAZ ANOKHA
programme.desc: After the resounding success of the first two seasons, EPIC Channel presents a revamped avatar of its Raja Rasoi series. EPIC Channel's Raja Rasoi series - titled Raja Rasoi Aur Andaaz Anokha - stands true to its name. While the lore and love of Indian food remains just as passionate, the new season presents a discovery oriented show format that transforms table-top cooking into an exciting food lab. Featuring renowned chef Ranveer Brar, the show will take you to his retreat – an old-world bungalow basking in the laidback vibe of Goa and then along on a ride nostalgia and rediscovery both personal and culinary. Ranveer's passion for culinary art makes him a perfect fit as the host for the latest season of the food series. He has dedicated this experimental streak and passion for food to his mentor – Munir Ahmed, a quaint, ordinary yet passionate food enthusiast from the gullies of Lucknow who greatly influenced Brar while growing up in his hometown.

programme.title: REGIMENT DIARIES
programme.desc: The Indian Army is an emotion – a living chronicle of events, that we have the luxury to forget because they remember. The army itself is a family of several regiments, each of which has its own history, identity, and glorious traditions. Regiment Diaries is a tale of the Indian Army unlike any told before. Told by the very men who follow the illustrious feats of their predecessors, it tells timeless tales that warm the heart, moisten the eye, and leave you in awe of the bravest children of India.

programme.title: SHARANAM
programme.desc: Sharanam takes viewers on a poignant journey to some of the most revered pilgrimage sites in India to and highlights the traditions, practices, rituals and ideals that bring people to these holy places in search of something greater than themselves. Narrated by Bollywood actress Juhi Chawla, Sharanam showcases testimonies of personal incidents that are the bedrock of the belief, and follows the strong thread of faith that not only binds the pilgrims to their Gods, but also the nation with itself.

programme.title: DESTRUCTION DECODED
programme.desc: This series will go back through the record to explore life-altering, earth-shattering, unforgettable events using a combination of carefully selected archive, cutting edge CGI and informative scripting in this popular science format. As well as exploring spectacular archive, illustrating the full toll these disasters can take, we'll dig into the science behind each event, shining a light on the most fascinating elements and giving an understanding on how and why these events occur

programme.title: Mercedes-Benz DRIVE PILOT Sensors S-Class
programme.desc: The exact location of a Mercedes equipped with DRIVE PILOT is determined using a high-precision positioning system that is much more powerful than conventional GPS systems. In addition to the anonymised data collected by LiDAR, camera, radar and ultrasound sensors, a digital HD map provides a three-dimensional image of the road and the surroundings with information on road geometry, route characteristics, traffic signs and special traffic events (e.g. accidents or road works). This high-precision map differs from maps for navigation devices by, among other things, its higher accuracy in the centimetre rather than metre range and its detailed junction and route model. The map data is stored in backend data centres and updated constantly. Each vehicle also stores an image of this map information on board, constantly compares it with the backend data and updates the local dataset as required. All of this enables stable and accurate positioning through a representation of the surroundings that is independent of factors such as shadows or dirty sensors.

programme.title: Kia Sportage Exterior Design in Lunar Silver
programme.desc: A number of new technologies optimize the precision and control of the chassis in a wide variety of weather and road conditions. The standard electronic damper control (Electronic Control Suspension, ECS) in the GT-line version increases comfort and safety thanks to the continuous damping control. The system reacts to body movements and steering inputs and changes the damping behavior at lightning speed in order to counteract the vehicle's diving, pitching and rolling movements when cornering. It also adjusts the damping force in the case of obstacles in order to cope with them as comfortably as possible and to reduce the influence of post-vibrations on the wheels. A premiere for the Sportage is the “All-Terrain-Mode”, which will be available for the plug-in hybrid version with all-wheel drive. The system offers intelligent support when driving off-road or on snow by automatically optimizing the vehicle settings depending on the selected mode and thus helping the SUV to achieve maximum traction on muddy, sandy or snowy surfaces.

Thanks to powerful electric motors, responsive 4MATIC all-wheel drive and an intelligent OFFROAD driving mode, the EQS SUV is also capable of tackling light terrain with ease. programme.title: Colour change with the power of thought
programme.sub-title: The BMW iX Flow meets neuro-technology
programme.desc: The Munich-based startup brainboost used the new and improved colour-changing effect in a one-off collaboration with the BMW Group at rad°hub aimed at raising awareness of mental health. With the help of brainboost, the BMW iX Flow was connected directly to the brain of the rad°hub delegates using an electroencephalograph (EEG), which records the brain's electrical activity. “The colour patterns of the BMW iX Flow react to brain activity and reflect the level of activity,” explains brainboost CEO Philipp Heiler. “Once the brain is at rest, the changes of patterns on the iX Flow also become calmer and more rhythmical.” A special animation was activated if delegates managed to maintain this state for several seconds. Thus, the participants were able to gradually calm and relax their brains under the guidance of the brainboost experts and with the help of neurofeedback via the iX Flow. This matures the knowledge of which strategies work best to specifically shut down one's own brain activity for relaxation, e.g. in everyday working life.

programme.desc: Host Joanna Chery elevates four Greek dishes using wine and spirits in this episode of One World Kitchen. First up, brown rice Stuffed Mussels infused with Greek dry white wine, tangy lemon juice, and fragrant spices - perfect for a sunny day by the sea. When evening rolls around, Joanna insists that red wine is a must! She makes a Sausage and Pepper Stew packed with golden-brown sausages and colourful bell peppers simmered in yummy tomatoes and a healthy dose of red wine. Then, she pulls out some brandy for a tender and delicious Beef Orzo Casserole. Finally, Joanna uses a traditional licorice-flavoured spirit called ouzo to bake a mouth-watering batch of Drunk Cookies.

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Cheese - a staple in traditional Greek cuisine! Talented home cook Joanna Chery fries up two delicious ap- petizers called Saganaki, both featuring two different types of cheese. First, she fries up kefaltyri, a hard, salty cheese in a dramatic burning flame of ouzo (licorice-flavoured alcohol) - Opa! Then, Joanna shows us a popular Fried Shrimp and Cheese appetizer using tasty feta and tender shrimp. Pair both dishes with a Greek rustic bread and you've nailed it! Next up, Joanna prepares a Greek classic - Spanakopita. This mouth-watering dish is made up of creamy ricotta, crispy phyllo pastry, fresh spinach, and a hint of dill (yum!). Moving on, Joanna showcases her all-time favourite Greek meal - Pastisio. For dessert, cheesy sweet tarts called Melitinia Cookies. Commonly served at parties, these ooey-gooey mascarpone-filled creations are to die for!

programme.title: One World Kitchen
programme.desc: Home cook Joanna Chery prepares a series of traditional Greek dishes including Stuffed Vine Leaves - a classic dish made of lemon-doused grape leaves and stuffed with fluffy rice, fragrant herbs, and juicy beef. Then, she prepares a healthy and hearty dish called Giant Baked Beans. Typically used as a side, it pairs well with Jo- anna's next dish - succulent roast lamb and lemony potatoes. Finally, Joanna makes a Greek specialty - Fried Dough Ribbons. Satisfy your sweet tooth with these fried, coiled dough ribbons drizzled with sweet honey and sprinkled with sugar. Simple, fun, and evERS-popular in Greek cuisine, this dish is great for sharing amongst family and friends.

programme.desc: Bloccata in un grande magazzino alla vigilia di Natale, una donna incontra una misteriosa guida che attraverso un paio di scarpe magiche le mostra possibilità diverse per la propria vita.

programme.title: Un magico Natale
programme.desc: Dopo un brutto incidente d'auto, Carrie Bishop si sveglia a Central Park, faccia a faccia con un angelo. L'angelo le dà la possibilità di cambiare la vita di un uomo d'affari in difficoltà e di guadagnarsi un posto in paradiso. Questo film è una storia di scoperta e del vero spirito del Natale.

programme.title: La cura del Natale
programme.desc: Quando Vanessa Thompson, una dottoressa che lavora sodo, torna a casa per Natale, il suo nome viene fuori per un'importante promozione al lavoro!

programme.title: Un matrimonio per Natale
programme.desc: Quando Haley torna nella sua casa per aiutare la sorella a pianificare il matrimonio perfetto, incontra la sua cotta e si ritrova a combattere tra la sua nuova vita e l'amore della sua vita.

programme.title: Per sempre Natale
programme.desc: Quando un uomo affascinante arriva in città e mette in discussione le sue tradizionali idee sulle feste, Carol deve imparare a scendere a compromessi, anche se questo significa vivere una storia d'amore inaspettata.

programme.title: Sorbole… che romagnola
programme.desc: Cult della commedia all'italiana . Una avvenente guida turistica romagnola, per l'errore di un'agenzia, è costretta a pagare un conto salatissimo nell'albergo dove alloggia. Essendo al verde, si reinventa dietologa, aiutando le mogli trascurate degli abitanti del luogo a tornare in forma.

programme.title: L'insegnante di violoncello
programme.desc: Arriva l'estate e Mario, giovane di buona famiglia, rifugge la noia prendendo lezioni di violoncello. A tenere il corso è la splendida e giunonica insegnante Margherita che con il suo fascino procace non tarda a turbare i sogni del volenteroso allievo.

programme.title: Amore mio
programme.desc: Un giovane commerciante in viaggio d'affari salva la vita a una ragazza che ha tentato il suicidio. Pur essendo sposato e padre di una bambina, l'uomo s'innamora della ragazza e l'assume come sua segretaria. Ben presto, la ragazza comprende che, con il suo egoistico amore, sta per distruggere l'unità di una famiglia, e decide così di restituire alla sua vera casa l'uomo che ama.

programme.title: Colpita da improvviso benessere
programme.desc: Elisabetta Mancini detta Betty, gestisce un banco del pesce ai mercati generali a Roma. Lo scopo di Betty è quello di avere successo per permettersi una vita agiata, nonostante Il suo compagno, l'anarchico Luiso Malerba, sia nemico non soltanto della borghesia e del lusso, ma anche del lavoro. Betty corromperà, faticherà e si indebiterà pur di ottenere quello che vuole.

programme.title: Cronache di poveri amanti
programme.desc: Grande classico di Carlo Lizzani con Marcello Mastroianni e Antonella Lualdi. Nel 1925, in pieno clima fascista, si intrecciano in un quartiere popolare di Firenze le vicende del tipografo Mario e della sua fidanzata, Bianca, con quelle degli altri abitanti. Nell'animato contesto, fra drammi personali, storie d'amore e piccole vicende quotidiane, la violenza politica nera scoppia brutalmente.

programme.title: La notte
programme.desc: Nel corso di una sola giornata a Milano, uno scrittore e sua moglie attraversano ospedali, feste e incontri che mettono a nudo la crisi del loro matrimonio, la solitudine e l'incapacità di comunicare.

programme.title: Il mantenuto
programme.desc: Stefano, impiegato in un'azienda farmaceutica, incontra Daniela, una giovane donna che si presenta come infermiera. Dietro l'incontro si nasconde però un piano che lo trascina in una serie di situazioni sentimentali e comiche.

programme.title: L'Impiegato
programme.desc: Un timido impiegato, soffocato dalla routine e dall'insicurezza, evade dalla vita quotidiana rifugiandosi in fantasie di successo e seduzione. L'incontro con una donna affascinante mette alla prova i suoi sogni.

programme.title: Cassandra Crossing
programme.desc: Due terroristi entrano in un laboratorio dove si sperimentano armi batteriologiche prodotte dai servizi segreti e contraggono un terribile virus. Uno dei due riesce a fuggire e a salire sul treno per Stoccolma dove contagia alcuni passeggeri. Ma i servizi segreti rintracciano il convoglio e decidono di deviarlo verso la Polonia. Lo scopo è farlo precipitare su un ponte pericolante il Cassandra Crossing, in modo che tutti muoiano e si perdano le tracce del terribile segreto...

programme.title: La decima vittima
programme.desc: In un futuro dove le guerre sono state abolite, per dare sfogo all`aggressività dell`individuo viene legalizzata la caccia all`uomo. Una volta entrati a far parte di un club internazionale e accettate le regole, ogni membro può essere sia cacciatore che preda. Dopo dieci battute di caccia portate a termine vengono concessi onori trionfali: Caroline, alla sua nona esperienza, parte per Roma, dove vive Marcello, la sua ultima preda...

programme.title: Ieri, oggi e domani
programme.desc: Trio di novelle, tre ritratti di donna che si avvalgono dell`eclettico brio interpretativo di Sophia Loren. Da un soggetto di Eduardo De Filippo: "Adelina", napoletana che vende sigarette di contrabbando e, per evitare il carcere, sforna figli a ripetizione da una novella di Aberto Moravia: "Anna", ricca milanese che, per noia, tradisce il marito con un giovane intellettuale squattrinato da un soggetto di Cesare Zavattini: "Mara", squillo d`alto bordo che fa invaghire un giovane seminarista.

programme.title: C'era una volta
programme.desc: Napoli, XVII secolo. Il principe Rodrigo Ferrantte y Davalos, nobile spagnolo di grande fascino e coraggio, è in Italia. Deve trovare una sposa e la corte gli impone la scelta tra sette belle principesse. Ma lui s`innamora di una paesana, semplice, fiera e sanguigna, di rara bellezza e di incredibili virtù, di nome Isabella. Il loro amore, fulmineo e improvviso, incontrerà molti ostacoli...

programme.title: Whitney
programme.desc: La vita di Whitney Houston viene esplorata in un documentario che rivela il contrasto tra la celebre diva e Nippy, il soprannome familiare della bambina dolce e allegra. La sua infanzia, più complessa di quanto noto, getta nuova luce sulla sua esistenza.

programme.title: Ribalta di gloria
programme.desc: La storia di Geroge Cohan, un musicista americano che raggiunge il successo componendo, nel 1917, una canzone destinata a diventare l'inno ufficiale delle truppe e che fa di lui un eroe nazionale.

programme.title: Monster on the Campus
programme.desc: Uno scienziato, entrando in contatto col plasma di un celacanto (pesce primordiale realmente esistente), subisce un'involuzione che lo trasforma in un primate dagli istinti omicidi.

programme.title: Remember
programme.desc: Remember racconta la storia di Zev (Christopher Plummer), che scopre che la guardia nazista responsabile della morte della sua famiglia vive in America sotto falso nome. Nonostante le difficoltà, Zev decide di farsi giustizia da solo, intraprendendo un viaggio intercontinentale con conseguenze inaspettate.

programme.title: UN NATALE DA SCOPRIRE
programme.desc: Il Natale nella campagna inglese non era nei piani di Emma fino a quando sua sorella Amy non ha deciso di organizzare il suo matrimonio per la vigilia di Natale. Dylan, il socio di Amy nel mercatino di Natale, collabora con Emma per mettere ordine nel caos dei preparativi.

programme.title: LE 12 SFIDE PER NATALE
programme.desc: La tranquilla stagione festiva di un'insegnante subisce una scossa quando accetta la sfida delle 12 prove di Natale lanciata dalla sorella, mentre si affretta a preparare la sua città per un programma di scambio natalizio con un affabile e supponente insegnante di francese.

programme.title: UN NATALE VERO E SINCERO
programme.desc: Un magico desiderio natalizio dona a un organizzatore di eventi la capacità di ascoltare ciò che tutti desiderano per le festività.

programme.title: COME IN UN FILM DI NATALE
programme.desc: Alla vigilia di una scadenza importante, una cinica maniaca del lavoro rimane bloccata in una piccola città del Colorado a causa di un guasto alle luci natalizie. Si ritrova così a recitare il ruolo di protagonista in un film natalizio in stile Hallmark.

programme.title: My Beautiful Laundrette
programme.desc: Rampollo di una ricca famiglia pachistana a Londra, Omar, ragazzo gay di buona volontà, propone allo zio di concedergli la gestione della vecchia lavanderia. Insieme a Johnny, suo amante, Omar rinnova il locale ma la Laundrette sarà presto presa di mira.

programme.title: Gantz revolution
programme.desc: Convocati dal misterioso globo di origine apparentemente aliena Kei e Masaru decidono di continuare a giocare per raggiungere il punteggio massimo disponibile assieme a lui anche diversi altri membri del team continuano a lavorare per Gantz.

programme.title: 400 Giorni
programme.desc: Quattro astronauti sono scelti dal governo americano per simulare una missione su un lontano pianeta e vengono rinchiusi in un sofisticato bunker sotterraneo per 400 giorni.

programme.title: Uno Anzi Due
programme.desc: Da quando suo padre è morto, Maurizio è sommerso dai debiti ma decide di nascondere tutto alla moglie e al figlio che sta per sposarsi. Un mare di debiti, bugie e malintesi nella commedia esilarante con Maurizio Battista e Claudia Pandolfi.

programme.title: 10th& Wolf
programme.desc: Un ex delinquente di strada torna a casa a Filadelfia dopo un periodo nell'esercito. Tornato in patria, si ritrova ancora una volta invischiato con il boss della mafia che è stato determinante nel suo diventare un soldato.

programme.title: Fight Club
programme.desc: Il protagonista è un rappresentante annoiato e stanco del proprio lavoro, che non dorme più la notte. Per non cadere in depressione frequenta un gruppo di discussione di malati, grazie ai quali si sente finalmente bene.

programme.title: Sharon Tate
programme.desc: Incinta del regista Roman Polanski e in attesa del suo ritorno dall'Europa, l'attrice Sharon Tate è perseguitata dalla visione di una sua imminente morte.

programme.title: Black Sea
programme.desc: Il capitano di sommergibili Robinson (Jude Law), con un divorzio alle spalle e un figlio adolescente con cui non ha quasi alcun rapporto, viene licenziato dalla sua società di recupero relitti.

programme.title: Awake Anestesia cosciente
programme.desc: Sebbene il suo corpo sia completamente paralizzato dall'anestesia, Clay rimane consapevole per tutta la durata dell'intervento, sperimentando così la 'consapevolezza intraoperatoria'. Questa esperienza, tra il delirio e la realtà, avrà ripercussioni nella sua vita perché emergeranno segreti nascosti.

programme.title: Beastly
programme.desc: Bello e arrogante, Kyle viene trasformato in un “mostro”. Solo l'amore vero potrà salvarlo. Una favola dark dove l'apparenza non conta più.

programme.title: Il Nido dei Calabroni
programme.desc: Un serial killer terrorizza Charlotte, nella Carolina del Nord. Spetterà al capo della polizia Judy Hammer e alla sua vice, Virginia West, scoprire il colpevole prima che colpisca di nuovo.

programme.title: Blood Money
programme.desc: Tre amici trovano milioni di dollari nascosti nel bosco, ma presto scoprono che appartengono a un criminale pericoloso. L'avidità e la paura trasformano il loro legame in un conflitto mortale, mentre cercano di sopravvivere alla furia del legittimo proprietario.

programme.title: Una festa da sogno
programme.desc: Kelly è una giovane, creativa e ambiziosa pianificatrice di eventi a New York e sta rapidamente guadagnando reputazione come una delle migliori nel settore. Ma quando Joe, un editore di siti web testardo, difficile ma influente, la assume per organizzare il compleanno della nipote di 10 anni, Kelly si rende rapidamente conto di aver appena incontrato il suo match.

programme.title: La Combinazione Perfetta
programme.desc: La professionista pianificatrice Gwen si impegna ad aiutare a mettere i tocchi finali al matrimonio della sua migliore amica. Ma quando viene abbinata al testimone Josh, una guida naturalistica, scopre che questo matrimonio potrebbe non essere così facile come pensava.

programme.title: Inaspettate passioni
programme.desc: Dopo una relazione finita, la giornalista Dana Willingham si ritrova sola e bloccata in un ritiro di yoga per coppie, mentre lo scoop più importante della sua carriera va in onda in sua assenza. E lo yoga nemmeno le piace! Ma forse l'universo l'ha messa qui per un motivo, perché l'affascinante solitario che soggiorna al rifugio si rivela essere Stefan Gonzales, il guru della technologia al centro dello scandalo. Mentre si guadagna la sua fiducia per smascherarlo, si scopre innamorata di lui. Ora deve usare le lezioni di yoga per scegliere: lo scoop perfetto o l'uomo perfetto?

programme.title: Amore alla moda
programme.desc: Quando Allie lascia la sua piccola città per trasferirsi a San Francisco ed inseguire il suo sogno di diventare stilista, non immagina neanche lontanamente che la città abbia in serbo grandi progetti per lei e per il suo cuore.

programme.title: La Regina del peccato
programme.desc: Dopo un incontro casuale con il carismatico e affascinante Jack, Posy Pinkerton coglie l'occasione per vivere un'ultima avventura prima di sistemarsi con il suo fidanzato Tom.

programme.title: Il segreto delle Api
programme.desc: La dottoressa Jean Markham torna nella città che aveva lasciato da adolescente per occuparsi dello studio del padre.

programme.title: Una moglie ideale
programme.desc: In questo sguardo oltraggiosamente divertente al matrimonio e alla sessualità negli anni '90, un uomo felicemente sposato convince la sua amorevole moglie ad aiutarlo a vivere la fantasia maschile definitiva.

programme.title: Un appuntamento con il destino
programme.desc: Jack è uno scrittore in difficoltà i cui ideali di speranza sono stati soppressi dal rifiuto e dalla solitudine, ma la sua vita è destinata a cambiare in seguito all'incontro con Maria, una ragazza allegra e molto superstiziosa.

programme.title: Una pasticceria da amare
programme.desc: Jessie Dale è una pasticcera di terza generazione che ama la sua pasticceria più di ogni altra cosa al mondo. Quando dei costruttori minacciano di acquistare il suo edificio costringendola ad andarsene, dovrà fare tutto il possibile per salvare la sua pasticceria.

programme.title: My Policeman
programme.desc: Storia di un amore proibito e dell'evoluzione delle convenzioni sociali, My Policeman segue le relazioni tra tre persone — il poliziotto Tom, l'insegnante Marion e il curatore museale Patrick — e il loro percorso emotivo che si snoda nel corso di diversi decenni.

programme.title: Semper Fi
programme.desc: Quando suo fratello uccide accidentalmente un uomo, un poliziotto rigoroso si trova diviso tra la famiglia e il lavoro, e presto si trova su un percorso di collisione che cambierà le loro vite per sempre.

programme.title: Pig
programme.desc: Rob (Nicolas Cage) è un ex grande chef ritiratosi nelle terre selvagge dell'Oregon. E' un uomo solitario, un cacciatore di tartufi accompagnato soltanto dal suo amato maiale.

programme.title: I segni del cuore
programme.desc: Ruby non è una liceale qualunque: le sue giornate iniziano su una barca da pesca, a fianco di suo fratello Leo, papà Frank e mamma Jackie, che sono tutti sordi. Ma la sua più grande passione è il canto e di talento ne ha da vendere.

programme.title: Just Like A Woman
programme.desc: Il viaggio da Chicago a Santa Fè di Marylin e Mona, entrambe in fuga per ragioni differenti. Un percorso improvvisato e precario, fonte di un'amicizia solidale tra le due giovani donne. Con Sienna Miller e Golshifteh Farahani.

programme.title: Vuoi cucinare con me?
programme.desc: Il comproprietario di un impero di fast-food scopre una cittadina del New Mexico dove i buongustai sbavano davanti alle prelibatezze culinarie di una bella ed esuberante cuoca.

programme.title: Finding Love in San Antonio
programme.desc: A una chef viene offerta la possibilità di lavorare in giro per l'Europa, ma teme di fare la scelta sbagliata per sua figlia, poiché la ragazza è legata alla città San Antonio, Texas. Tuttavia, gli affari del suo ristorante non vanno a gonfie vele.

programme.title: Tutta colpa del cioccolato
programme.desc: Mentre si prepara per l'annuale Masters of Chocolate Festival, i piani di Aria vengono sconvolti quando perde il suo partner prima della competizione. Tuttavia, un uomo affascinante interviene presto per aiutare Aria a trovare l'ingrediente vincente.

programme.title: Come salvare il Natale
programme.desc: Megan usa le settimane che precedono ogni Natale per aiutare gli altri. Chiamata a salvare la festa di Natale della sua cittadina, la ragazza si ritrova contesa tra l'uomo dei suoi sogni e il partner ideale.

programme.title: La storia dell'amore
programme.desc: C'era una volta un ragazzo, Léo, che amava una ragazza, Alma. Le aveva promesso che l'avrebbe fatta ridere per tutta la vita, ma la guerra li ha separati. Da un paesino della Polonia negli anni Trenta alla New York dei giorni nostri ripercorriamo la straordinaria storia d'amore tra Léo, l'uomo che è sopravvissuto a tutto e Alma, la donna più amata del mondo. Oggi un'altra Alma, adolescente newyorchese e contagiata dallo stesso virus meraviglioso dell'amore, vuole essere la donna più amata del mondo. Sembra che niente leghi Léo alla giovane Alma ma… L'amore attraverserà il tempo e i continenti per unire i loro destini.

programme.title: La storia dell'amore
programme.desc: C'era una volta un ragazzo, Léo, che amava una ragazza, Alma. Le aveva promesso che l'avrebbe fatta ridere per tutta la vita, ma la guerra li ha separati. Da un paesino della Polonia negli anni Trenta alla New York dei giorni nostri ripercorriamo la straordinaria storia d'amore tra Léo, l'uomo che è sopravvissuto a tutto e Alma, la donna più amata del mondo. Oggi un'altra Alma, adolescente newyorchese e contagiata dallo stesso virus meraviglioso dell'amore, vuole essere la donna più amata del mondo. Sembra che niente leghi Léo alla giovane Alma ma… L'amore attraverserà il tempo e i continenti per unire i loro destini.

programme.title: La storia dell'amore
programme.desc: C'era una volta un ragazzo, Léo, che amava una ragazza, Alma. Le aveva promesso che l'avrebbe fatta ridere per tutta la vita, ma la guerra li ha separati. Da un paesino della Polonia negli anni Trenta alla New York dei giorni nostri ripercorriamo la straordinaria storia d'amore tra Léo, l'uomo che è sopravvissuto a tutto e Alma, la donna più amata del mondo. Oggi un'altra Alma, adolescente newyorchese e contagiata dallo stesso virus meraviglioso dell'amore, vuole essere la donna più amata del mondo. Sembra che niente leghi Léo alla giovane Alma ma… L'amore attraverserà il tempo e i continenti per unire i loro destini.

programme.title: Motel Woodstock
programme.desc: Il film racconta la storia di Tiber, un uomo comune che gestiva assieme ai genitori un motel, tenendo nascosta la propria omosessualità. Tiber fu l'uomo che riuscì a trovare il luogo adatto e le licenze necessarie per dar vita ad uno degli eventi che hanno segnato la storia della musica, del costume e non solo, il Festival di Woodstock.

programme.title: The greatest movie ever sold
programme.desc: Morgan Spurlock rivela il lato nascosto del mondo del marketing attaccando con grande umorismo la pubblicità illegittima nel cinema e in televisione attraverso il cosiddetto product placement.

programme.title: The greatest movie ever sold
programme.desc: Morgan Spurlock rivela il lato nascosto del mondo del marketing attaccando con grande umorismo la pubblicità illegittima nel cinema e in televisione attraverso il cosiddetto product placement.

programme.title: Un neomelodico presidente
programme.desc: Il cantante neomelodico Leopoldo Giappone, in arte Mimmo Dany, si candida a presidente della regione Campania con una lista a sé, l'UVC. Il suo sogno tuttavia resta quello di partecipare al reality show L'isola dei famosi, e per questo ha a che fare con la malavita.

programme.title: Maledimiele
programme.desc: Maledimiele è la storia di Sara, un'adolescente di quindici anni che si ammala di anoressia. Inizialmente nessuno sembra accorgersi di niente: sia i genitori che le amiche del cuore faticano a vedere l'evolversi della malattia…

programme.title: Friends with Money
programme.desc: Il film esamina i mutevoli rapporti tra quattro donne la cui amicizia di lunga data è minacciata dalla crescente disparità del loro stato finanziario. Le tre amiche ricche, Frannie, Jane e Christine, condividono una preoccupazione per Olivia, che sembra incapace di guadagnarsi da vivere o di portare avanti una relazione, almeno per i loro standard.

programme.title: LE AVVENTURE DI JOE DIRT
programme.desc: Abbandonato dai genitori da bambino, Joe Dirt (David Spade) ha dovuto crescere da solo. Ma ora vuole ritrovarli. Nel suo viaggio incontra un custode di liceo (Christopher Walken), un'istruttrice di alligatori (Rosanna Arquette), la bellissima ma intoccabile Brandy (Brittany Daniel), e Robby (Kid Rock), il rivale di Joe.

programme.title: Non È Un'Altra Stupida Commedia Americana
programme.desc: Questo film è una parodia delle convenzioni e i cliché del suo genere. L'esclusa della scuola, Janey Briggs (Chyler Leigh), un'aspirante artista con occhiali, coda di cavallo e una perenne salopette macchiata di pittura, è l'oggetto di una scommessa tra il giocatore di football Jake Wyler (Chris Evans) e Austin (Eric Christian Olsen) che non può essere trasformata nella “reginetta del ballo”.

programme.title: Io, Lei E I Suoi Bambini
programme.desc: Ice Cube è Nick, un playboy incallito che tenta di conquistare una giovane e bella divorziata, Suzanne (Nia Long).

programme.title: I due crociati
programme.desc: Ciccio e Franco, disastri tra Crociati e Saraceni, rovesciano per caso le sorti dello scontro finale.

programme.title: Tre tigri contro tre tigri
programme.desc: Secondo film ad episodi dal cast vincente: Pozzetto, Cochi, Villaggio e Montesano

programme.title: Il fidanzamento
programme.desc: La madre di Mirella vuole che Luigi sposi sua figlia, ma lui non vuole rinunciare al ruolo di fidanzato.

programme.title: Le favolose notti d'Oriente
programme.desc: Due lestofanti raccontano Le Mille e una notte erotiche per soddisfare lo sceicco e salvarsi la vita.

programme.title: Brutti Sporchi e cattivi
programme.desc: Commedia nera e grottesca in una baraccopoli romana: Nino Manfredi è Giacinto, patriarca pugliese che difende il suo denaro tra furti e scherzi familiari. Capolavoro di Ettore Scola, vincitore del premio miglior regia a Cannes.

programme.title: Il fischio al naso
programme.desc: Un uomo, interpretato da Ugo Tognazzi, si ritrova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni comiche e paradossali, tutto a causa di un fischio al naso che cambia inaspettatamente la sua vita. Una commedia surreale e ironica che esplora la follia delle circostanze.

programme.title: Vita da cani
programme.desc: Le vite di diversi personaggi si intrecciano in un susseguirsi di difficoltà quotidiane e situazioni comiche. Aldo Fabrizi, Gina Lollobrigida e Marcello Mastroianni sono protagonisti di una commedia che racconta le piccole disavventure della vita, con ironia e causticità.

programme.title: Totò cerca casa
programme.desc: Totò è un uomo alla ricerca disperata di una casa, ma si trova coinvolto in una serie di situazioni esilaranti e complicate. Tra inganni e malintesi, il film esplora con ironia le difficoltà della vita quotidiana.

programme.title: Totò Sexy
programme.desc: Due suonatori ambulanti finiscono in carcere per contrabbando e si rifugiano in sogni popolati da donne seducenti e atmosfere esotiche. Una commedia musicale guidata dall'ironia inconfondibile di Totò, tra gag surreali e fantasia.

programme.title: La ragazza di San Diego (2020)
programme.desc: In questo adattamento musicale del film del 1983 che ha cambiato per sempre la vita degli adolescenti americani, Julie (Jessica Rothe) è l'estrema Valley Girl degli anni '80 che si innamora di Randy (Josh Whitehouse), un punk rocker di Hollywood!

programme.title: La ragazza del mio migliore amico
programme.desc: Alexis è la donna dei sogni di Dustin, ma quando lui diventa ossessivo, Alexis tronca la relazione. Dustin chiede aiuto all'amico Tank, maestro nella seduzione. Ma con Alexis le strategie di Tank non funzionano e lui stesso si ritroverà attratto dalla ragazza del suo migliore amico.

programme.title: Nonno Scatenato
programme.desc: Alla morte della nonna, Jason e suo nonno Dick partono per il viaggio più selvaggio della loro vita. Tra feste, risse da bar e una serata epica di karaoke, le imminenti nozze di Jason saranno messe a rischio dall'irrefrenabilità del nonno.

programme.title: A Little White Lie
programme.desc: Un tuttofare vive e lavora a New York City dove viene scambiato per uno scrittore famoso e viene portato in un'università. Qui dovrà tenere il discorso di apertura per salvare il festival letterario dell'istituto.

programme.title: Finché giudice non ci separi
programme.desc: Massimo, Paolo, Roberto e Mauro sono quattro amici, tutti separati e accomunati dal rancore verso il giudice che ha seguito le loro separazioni. Situazioni paradossali e sorprese sempre dietro l'angolo, in una commedia divertentissima.

programme.title: Interstate 60
programme.desc: Dal creatore di Ritorno al Futuro. Neil è un pittore ostacolato dal padre che vorrebbe vederlo laureato in legge. La situazione cambia all'improvviso quando incontra One Wish Grant (premio Oscar Gary Oldman), uomo in grado di esaudire ogni desiderio.

programme.title: La casa dei sogni
programme.desc: Una coppia cerca la casa perfetta in cui andare a vivere e decide di assumere un architetto. L'uomo, invece di svolgere il lavoro per il quale era stato assunto, progetta la dimora dei propri sogni.

programme.title: Company Man
programme.desc: Per evitare la moglie petulante, un insegnante si finge agente segreto della CIA e viene reclutato per rovesciare la dittatura di Fidel Castro a Cuba.

programme.title: Il Ratto delle Sabine
programme.desc: Tra rivalità, passioni e battaglie nell'antica Roma, il destino di due popoli si decide in uno scontro che cambierà la storia.

programme.title: Messalina
programme.desc: Con Belinda Lee, Messalina intreccia seduzione e potere nella Roma imperiale tra passioni e congiure.

programme.title: Robin, frecce, fagioli e karate
programme.desc: Un improbabile eroe si ritrova coinvolto in combattimenti e situazioni esilaranti tra azione e comicità. Diretto da Tonino Ricci.

programme.title: Robin Hood, l'invincibile arciere
programme.desc: Robin Hood salva Sir Allan Clare durante il viaggio verso Nottingham e decide di aiutarlo a liberare Isabella, promessa sposa del cavaliere ma ostacolata dal proprio zio. Tra imboscate, prigionia e tradimenti, l'arciere sfida ancora una volta i potenti.

programme.title: Golia e il cavaliere mascherato
programme.desc: Tra castelli, duelli e congiure, Golia affronta nemici mascherati per difendere il regno e ristabilire la giustizia.

programme.title: La morte sull'alta collina
programme.desc: Un'importante rapina va male, mentre due giovani uomini si ritrovano a ostacolare banditi messicani e malvagi uomini d'affari corrotti che vogliono indietro il loro bottino rubato.

programme.title: 10.000 dollari per un massacro
programme.desc: Django, cacciatore di taglie, viene incaricato di catturare un malvivente che ha rapito una ragazza. Ritenendo la ricompensa insufficiente, si allea con il bandito, ma ben presto viene tradito dal criminale senza scrupoli, costringendolo a cercare giustizia e vendetta da solo.

programme.title: Il bianco il giallo il nero
programme.desc: Nel XIX secolo un pony sacro, dono dell'imperatore giapponese al presidente USA, viene rubato da indiani rinnegati. Lo sceriffo Gideon deve consegnare il riscatto con l'aiuto di Sakura, servo convinto di essere samurai, e del misterioso vagabondo Blanc De Blanc.

programme.title: Custer eroe del West
programme.desc: L'amore di George Armstrong Custer per le tradizioni eroiche del Calvario e il suo disgusto per l'avvento dell'industrializzazione lo portano al suo destino al Little Big Horn.

programme.title: È tornato Sabata... hai chiuso un'altra volta!
programme.desc: Il feroce pistolero Sabata protegge i deboli e caccia un sindaco corrotto che ha truffato un'intera città.

programme.title: Faccia a faccia
programme.desc: Un professore di storia incrocia casualmente un noto fuorilegge e finisce per guidare la sua banda.

programme.title: Sette ore di fuoco
programme.desc: Buffalo Bill guida una carovana di pionieri e affronta una banda di contrabbandieri che vende armi ai Sioux.

programme.title: I quattro inesorabili
programme.desc: Quattro cacciatori di taglie del Texas cercano vendetta contro un ranger che ha scagionato il loro ricercato.
